svg.desc: Twelve systems/views including Sparkle, vendor frameworks, selected framework libraries and engineers' portfolio examples. Separate responsibility categories: Rendering, RHI, Shaders, Scene/world, Core/foundations and Rest. Two rows include selected dependency components; they are not full dependency closures. Pinned totals and category values are in peer-proportions.csv.
svg.title: Measured source proportions in twelve public rendering repositories
Measured source proportions in twelve public rendering repositories

ns2:Work.dc:title: Measured source proportions in twelve public rendering repositories
ns2:Work.dc:description: Twelve systems/views including Sparkle, vendor frameworks, selected framework libraries and engineers' portfolio examples. Separate responsibility categories: Rendering, RHI, Shaders, Scene/world, Core/foundations and Rest. Two rows include selected dependency components; they are not full dependency closures. Pinned totals and category values are in peer-proportions.csv.

g.text: Zero means no separately mapped local category. Delegated and mixed responsibilities are documented in the report.
